title: Ultimate beneficial ownership and control graph
workflow: Start with legally registered target entity and its owners
Collect source-backed direct ownership, voting and special control claims
Follow intermediate organizations while tracking cycles and uncertainty
Calculate candidate indirect control only under approved policy
Escalate nominees, inconsistencies, politically exposed owners and opaque chains
Approve reviewed graph version with legal/KYB audit references
requirements: No universal ownership threshold may be hardcoded without verified applicable jurisdiction policy
Graph traversal must detect loops and terminate deterministically
Indirect percentage is a derived candidate, not source-verified fact by default
Ownership, voting rights, and control via agreements must remain distinct dimensions
Unknown owner is an explicit state, not zero ownership
All graph and identity evidence access must be constrained to legitimate institution purpose
acceptance_tests: Detect cyclic corporate ownership without infinite recursion
Mixed voting and equity relationships do not get collapsed
Graph update preserves prior effective history
Missing evidence leaves beneficial owner unresolved
Cross-tenant relationship cannot expose another institution's customer
gate: Applicable beneficial-ownership obligations, verified policy thresholds, registries and independent AML/legal approval.
